key_insight: This study shows that small language models can help detect Bangla health misinformation, but they work best when paired with a culturally sensitive evaluation framework.
clinical_relevance: It supports more trustworthy health-information screening for Bangla-speaking communities, where English-focused AI tools often miss local language and cultural nuance.
method: Evaluated several small language models on a Bangla-translated health misinformation dataset.
Compared model performance for claim extraction, highlighting precision-recall balance.
Added a Responsible NLP framework considering cultural sensitivity, potential harm, and communication quality.
evidence_signal: In the abstract, Phi-4 performed best for claim extraction, showing the strongest balance between precision and recall on the Bangla dataset.
watch_item: The approach depends on translated and low-resource data, so real-world performance may vary across dialects, topics, and evolving misinformation patterns.
paper_title: Evaluating Health Misinformation in Low-Resource Languages: Integrating Small Language Models with a Culturally-Sensitive Responsible NLP Framework (Bangla as a Case Study)
